summary: Braskem S.A. furnished a routine Form 6-K containing its monthly Brazilian securities-trading disclosure under Article 11 of CVM Resolution 44/2021, consolidating September 2026 activity by management, board members, related persons, and controlling shareholders. No transactions were reported for most categories; the filing reports holdings balances such as 438,761,574 common shares and 123,055,912 Class A preferred shares, plus minor preferred-share and agribusiness receivables certificate positions. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure mapped to a US Form 8-K equivalent, with no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
